title: git tricks
content:
Git Advanced Tips & Tricks: Notes (Fireship)

Idea: Git achhe se aana chahiye. Galat Git use se merge conflicts aur failed checks aate hain, aur Stack Overflow pe panic hota hai.

1. Add + Commit ek saath (-am)

bash
git commit -am "fix: login bug"
  • git add . aur git commit ka kaam ek command mein.
  • ⚠️ Assumption/correction: Ye sirf already tracked files ko add karta hai. Nayi (untracked) files ke liye pehle git add zaroori hai.

2. Aliases (shortcuts)

Git config mein custom shortcuts banao:

bash
git config --global alias.ac '!git add -A && git commit -m'
# Use:
git ac "added navbar"
  • Aur common examples: git config --global alias.st status, alias.co checkout.

3. Last commit fix karna (--amend)

Situation Command
Commit message mein typo git commit --amend -m "new message"
Koi file add karna bhool gaye git add file.js → git commit --amend
Message same rakhna hai git commit --amend --no-edit
  • ⚠️ Sirf tab use karo jab commit push nahi hua ho.

4. Force Push (risky)

bash
git push --force
  • Remote ke commit ko tumhare local code se overwrite kar deta hai.
  • Agar remote pe aise commits hain jo tumhare paas nahi, to wo hamesha ke liye gayab. Teammates naraz honge.
  • 💡 Safer option: git push --force-with-lease (remote badla ho to rok deta hai).

5. Push ho chuka kharab code: git revert

bash
git revert <commit-hash>
  • Naya commit banata hai jo purane commit ko undo kar de.
  • Original commit history se delete nahi hota, isliye shared branches pe safe hai.
  • vs reset: reset history rewrite karta hai, revert nahi.

6. Laptop ke bina kaam karna

  • . key (period): GitHub repo kholo aur . dabao. Browser mein VS Code (github.dev) khul jaata hai. Edit aur PR kar sakte ho, par terminal nahi milta.
  • GitHub Codespaces: Cloud pe full VS Code + terminal. Stashes bhi cloud mein save rehte hain.

7. Git Stash: kaam ko temporarily side rakhna

Use case: changes adhoore hain, commit nahi kar sakte, par branch switch karni hai.

bash
git stash                      # changes hide
git stash pop                  # wapas lao (stash delete ho jaata hai)

git stash push -m "navbar wip" # naam ke saath
git stash list                 # sab stashes dekho
git stash apply stash@{0}      # index se apply (stash bacha rehta hai)
  • pop vs apply: pop apply karke stash hata deta hai, apply nahi hatata.
  • Video mein stash save bola, par ab stash push -m recommended hai.

8. master → main rename

bash
git branch -M main
  • 2020 ke baad main preferred naam hai.
  • Remote pe bhi update karna ho: git push -u origin main.

9. Readable Git Log

bash
git log --graph --oneline --decorate
  • --graph: branches ka visual structure
  • --oneline: ek commit = ek line
  • --decorate: branch/tag names dikhata hai
  • 💡 Alias bana lo: git config --global alias.lg "log --graph --oneline --decorate"

10. Bug dhundhna: git bisect

Binary search se pata lagao ki kis commit ne bug daala.

bash
git bisect start
git bisect bad                 # current commit kharab hai
git bisect good <hash>         # ye commit sahi tha
# Git beech ka commit checkout karega, test karo:
git bisect good   # ya   git bisect bad
# ... repeat, final mein guilty commit mil jaata hai
git bisect reset               # khatam, wapas normal
  • 100 commits mein sirf ~7 steps lagte hain (log₂100).

11. Commits Squash karna (Interactive Rebase)

Use case: feature branch pe 3 faltu commits ko 1 clean commit banana.

bash
git rebase -i main

Editor mein commands:

Command Matlab
pick commit as it is rakho
reword sirf message badlo
squash pichle commit mein merge karo (messages combine)
fixup squash jaisa, par message discard

Pro tip (auto-squash):

bash
git commit --fixup <hash>        # pehle se mark kar do
git rebase -i --autosquash main  # apne aap squash

12. Git Hooks

  • Git events (commit, push etc.) se pehle/baad mein custom scripts chalte hain.
  • Location: .git/hooks/
  • Husky (JS devs ke liye): hooks ko easily configure karta hai.
bash
npm install husky --save-dev
  • Example: pre-commit hook pe lint/test chalao, jisse kharab code commit hi na ho.

13. Reset & Cleanup (Sab kuch saaf)

bash
git fetch origin
git reset --hard origin/main   # local = remote (local changes gone ⚠️)
git clean -fd                  # untracked files/folders delete
  • 💡 Pehle git clean -n se dry-run karo, dekhne ke liye kya delete hoga.
  • Nuclear option: .git folder delete karo, to Git history hi khatam (joke: "SVN try karo").

Bonus: Previous branch pe jaana

bash
git checkout -
# modern: git switch -
  • Branch ka naam bhool gaye? Ye seedha pichli branch pe le jaayega.

Quick Cheat Sheet

Kaam Command
Add + commit git commit -am "msg"
Last commit edit git commit --amend
Undo pushed commit git revert <hash>
Work save/side git stash / git stash pop
Pretty log git log --graph --oneline --decorate
Bug dhundho git bisect
Commits merge git rebase -i main
Remote jaisa banao git fetch + git reset --hard
Untracked delete git clean -fd
Pichli branch git checkout -
